sql_templates.name: LatestQuarterlyResultsAnalysis
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_results AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, period_end, revenue, pat, opm_pct
  FROM scores.quarterly_results
  WHERE period_end > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  ORDER BY symbol, period_end DESC, fetched_at DESC
),
latest_analysis AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (symbol) symbol, verdict, growth_yoy_revenue_pct, growth_yoy_pat_pct, opm_delta_pp
  FROM scores.results_analysis
  WHERE period_end > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '3 months'
  ORDER BY symbol, period_end DESC, updated_at DESC
)
SELECT lr.symbol, lr.revenue, lr.pat, lr.opm_pct, la.verdict, la.growth_yoy_revenue_pct, la.growth_yoy_pat_pct, la.opm_delta_pp
FROM latest_results lr
JOIN latest_analysis la ON lr.symbol = la.symbol
LIMIT 10;
